entities.summary: Baku Sports Palace is an indoor arena located in Baku, Azerbaijan. Originally, the arena was named Palace of Hand Games until 2015. It is located near the Baku Boulevard on the Caspian Sea coast. It was built in 1974 and renovated in 2015. The arena consists of 1736 seats.
